theme: Behavioural finance: volatility ≠ loss, avoiding panic selling, staying invested
headline: Market Swings Are Not Permanent Losses
body: Volatility is temporary price movement. Losses only materialize if you sell during downturns. Staying invested through cycles helps recover value.
caption: Market fluctuations test investor patience, but panic selling locks in losses unnecessarily. Historical data shows markets recover, rewarding those who remain invested through volatility. Emotional discipline matters more than timing. #BehaviouralFinance #StayInvested #MarketVolatility #InvestmentDiscipline #LongTermWealth
